name: veurone-studio
description: Make motion-graphics videos for training and explainers from a chat, in your Veurone Studio.

interface.longDescription:
Make motion-graphics videos for training, onboarding and explainers from a chat. ChatGPT asks what you need and writes the script with you, then builds the video in your Veurone Studio: scenes, a voice-over, music, pictures drawn for the story and 3D presenters. Look at frames in the chat, ask for changes, and share a link anyone can watch. Every video opens in Veurone Studio, where you can edit it by hand.

For people who make training, onboarding and product videos. You need a Veurone account. Courses and full eLearning designs can be built the same way.

From the chat you can't delete videos or export MP4 files: those happen in Veurone Studio. Voice-overs use what your Veurone account includes. Building a video uses your ChatGPT plan and takes several minutes.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second video for new staff on spotting phishing emails.
List my Veurone Studio videos and show me a frame from the latest.
Turn this policy into a short training video with a voice-over.

positive.description: Lists the videos in the connected account.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's videos by name, including Spot a phishing email, with how long each one is.

positive.description: Shows a frame of a video in the chat.
positive.prompt: Show me a frame from the middle of my Spot a phishing email video.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a still image from the video in the chat, and says which scene it is from.

positive.description: Writes a script for a new video and waits for the person's go before voicing or building anything.
positive.prompt: Make a 30-second video for new office staff about locking their screen when they leave their desk. Use the Clear style, Owen's voice and clean captions, with no presenter.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks about anything still open, then shows the script scene by scene and waits. No voice-over is made yet.

positive.description: Builds the video from the approved script.
positive.prompt: The script is good, build it.
positive.tools_triggered: generate_voiceover, add_sound, apply_edits, validate_project, render_frames, play_video
positive.expected_behavior: After a few minutes, says the video is built and plays it in the chat. The video keeps the script's words. ChatGPT asks once to allow changes to the video: choose Always allow.

positive.description: Shares a built video on a link.
positive.prompt: Share my Spot a phishing email video and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a watch.veurone.com link. Opening it plays the video in a browser, with no sign-in.

negative.description: Nothing can be deleted from the chat: it says so and points to Veurone Studio, and changes nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete all my Veurone Studio videos.

negative.description: Plans and voice minutes can't be bought from the chat: it says so, and at most links to Veurone's plans page, with no checkout.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Veurone plan and buy more voice minutes.

negative.description: Only the connected account can be reached: it says it can't see anyone else's videos, and shows nothing of theirs.
negative.prompt: Show me the videos in my colleague's Veurone account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin doesn't sell anything or take payments. When a person's account has run out of voice minutes it says so and can link to Veurone's plans page, which is informational.

publication.release_notes: First release: make, change, look at and share videos in Veurone Studio from a chat.
